title: Row and Say ABC
hook: Sea and boat words ride with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one clear beat between cue and target
visualStyle: playful nautical 3D storybook, toy boats and ocean creatures, navy-aqua-red accents, clean separable subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: friendly boat crew calling sea clues from deck
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: crew response hook with strong beat-one returns
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: short deck calls mixed with fuller scene lines; semantic fact lands after the target
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: crew caller leaves a beat, group confirms, then matching gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: verses use brushes/accordion breaths; chorus adds claps; retrieval sections use bare stomp and voice
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft stomp on beat one, accordion answer off the target onset
